notes: Univox is a hearing-loop/assistive-listening brand of Bo Edin AB (Sweden). PLS-7 is a 1U/19" induction (hearing) loop amplifier, part no. 217700 (EU/AUS/UK/US mains-plug variants). Ports listed are for the standard (non-Dante) PLS-7. An optional Dante-equipped sibling, PLS-7D (part no. 217710), adds a proprietary plug-in Dante-interface module that exposes an RJ45 Dante PoE audio input — intentionally omitted here since it is not present on the base PLS-7 chassis and no Ethernet link-speed grade is published for it. The amplifier's own power connector is a 4-pin locking DC socket labeled "DC"; true AC mains (90-260VAC, 50/60Hz) terminates at the separate external power-supply brick included in the box, not at the chassis, so no IEC/AC inlet is listed on the unit itself. Several rear outputs (Monitor speaker, Aux DC power, Loop Fault relay) physically share one 6-position Phoenix/Euroblock terminal block labeled "Monitor" / "Loop Fault" on the rear panel — split into three logical ports here per the manufacturer's own connections diagram. Chassis width is 430mm (rack ears/brackets included to fit standard 19" rails). Data drawn directly from Univox's own "7-Series" datasheet (pls-sls-7-br-gb-2022-12-19) and Installation Guide PDFs, both hosted at univox.eu, including the labeled rear-panel connector diagram.

ports.name: Input 1
ports.note: Balanced mic/line XLR; dip-switch Mic/Line sensitivity (-55 dBu to +10 dBu), +12VDC phantom power on/off, switchable low-cut filter (130-170 Hz)

ports.name: Input 2
ports.note: Balanced Phoenix screw terminal; switchable Line level (-15 dBu to +20.6 dBu) or 50-100V speaker-level line input, plus override/priority (evac) function

ports.name: Input 3
ports.note: Unbalanced input (-24 dBu to +16.2 dBu); fed via stereo RCA L/R jacks (summed) or an alternate unbalanced Phoenix screw terminal wired to the same input

ports.name: Loop
ports.note: 4-position rear screw terminal; complementary balanced induction-loop drive output, up to 100 Vpp / 20 Arms

ports.name: Monitor (Speaker Out)
ports.note: Drives an 8-32 ohm external monitor speaker (pins 1+2, pin2=GND); shares a 6-position rear 'Miscellaneous outputs' Phoenix block with the Aux DC and Loop Fault ports below

ports.name: Aux DC Power Out
ports.note: Auxiliary DC output, 12-18VDC at 100mA (pins 3+2, pin2=GND), on the same shared rear terminal block; not separately silk-screened

ports.name: Loop Fault
ports.note: Dry relay contact for remote fault/PA monitoring on the shared rear terminal block: open contact = fault, closed = OK

ports.name: Monitor
ports.note: Front-panel 3.5mm headphone jack for loop monitoring; shares a level pot with the rear Monitor speaker output

ports.name: DC
ports.note: Rear-panel 4-pin locking DC power inlet, fed by the included external power supply (mains 90-260VAC 50/60Hz enters at that external brick, not the chassis); closest listed connector id to the round 4-pin 'DC' socket shown in the manual
